sloka: रामलक्ष्मणयोर्द्दष्ट्वा शरीरे सायकैश्चिते ।सर्वाणि चाङ्गोपाङ्गानि सुग्रीवं भयमाविशत् ।। ६.४६.३० ।।।।
transliteration: rāmalakṣmaṇayorddaṣṭvā śarīre sāyakaiścite ।sarvāṇi cāṅgopāṅgāni sugrīvaṁ bhayamāviśat ।। 6.46.30 ।।।।

translations.english: Sugriva was overtaken by fear on seeing Rama and Lakshmana riddled with arrows from head to foot all over the body
